svg.text: Amp ADSR release envelope fall time
UP: SINE · MID: TRI/SQR · DN: SAW
Also selects preset slot 1/2/3 while holding FSW 2
Hold >350 ms: knobs shift to delay/reverb
LED 1 reflects engaged / bypassed / edit state
Sharp pluck transient to slow ambient swell
UP: OFF · MID: DELAY · DN: REVERB
Bypass delay/reverb cleanly in UP position
Flip Toggle 2 to recall QSPI slot 1/2/3
While holding FSW 2, tap FSW 1 to save
